description: This file implements the 'WidevinePlatformDRM' class, providing methods for handling Widevine DRM decryption operations, including decryption with handles and session IDs. It interfaces with lower-level hardware memory via handle conversions and delegates decryption to an underlying CDM object.

classes.name: WidevinePlatformDRM
classes.description: A class responsible for managing Widevine DRM decryption, interfacing with hardware memory and the CDM.

methods.name: WidevinePlatformDRM(widevine::Cdm * cdm)
methods.description: Constructor for the WidevinePlatformDRM class, initializes the platform with a CDM reference.

methods.name: ~WidevinePlatformDRM()
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the platform instance.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const std::string & session_id,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Performs decryption using a handle and a decryption batch, converting the handle to secure memory and invoking CDM decryption.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Performs decryption using a handle and a session ID with a decryption batch, similar to the other overload but includes session context.
